source.implementation: independent FP32 vector reference, full native16 key/48 value heads, two tokens

hypothesis: Replace all three K-row state loops with bulk FP32 vector products, repeat-DSD four-partial reductions and pointwise outer update. Reuse only the dead current-frame STATE_HISTORY slot as product scratch; protected save_frame still writes every final state. Execute every product with FP32 MUL/ADD under the original gamma2K/gamma2 bounds; original BF16 output conversion, exact canonical/replica checks and all frames remain. Local mem4d descriptors loaded sequentially into DSR bank zero avoid global descriptor register pressure and constant lowering defects.
falsification: Reject incorrect mem4d flattening/reduction, any omitted K*V term/frame/state store, reuse of a past history or live/canonical buffer, scratch extent outside the current frame, changed precision or timing, fixed local/full-chain error failure, shutdown/core/timer failure, speedup below1.05x or memory above1.10x. Require full six-case fresh pairs and exact suite coverage for widening claims.
